scope: Three Cycles still views at frame 18; no photographic reference was supplied or inspected.
positive_observations: Top view visibly establishes hollow nozzle, cup wall/rim thickness, thick base, and distinct liquid free surface.
Vessel and witness cylinder have grounded soft contact shadows.
Metal witness carries shaped reflections and rounded edges.
No visible excessive bloom or overall blown-out wash.

findings.finding: Obvious granular render noise obscures optical surfaces, silhouette edges, and the stream.
findings.acceptance_check: Inspect the same three images at native 640x640 after higher sampling or a validated denoising pass; wall, free surface and stream details must remain visibly interpretable without heavy grain.

findings.finding: Bright broad card/light contributions make the lower volume resemble a pale opaque sleeve or insert, especially in hero.
findings.acceptance_check: Keep the refractive witness useful while reducing its dominant white contribution; the fill should read as a transparent volume with refracted detail and a distinct free surface.

findings.finding: The stream nearly disappears across part of the gap between the nozzle and receiving vessel, preventing confident continuous-flow reading.
findings.acceptance_check: From nozzle to impact, preserve a visible continuous edge or reflection in all three matched views without turning the stream opaque.

findings.finding: A single scene_manifest.json is overwritten by sequential cameras, losing camera-specific timing and prior GLB export status.
findings.acceptance_check: Retain one manifest per camera or an aggregate containing each camera, frame, output hash, renderer metadata, render seconds, and export evidence.

findings.finding: Only a single still-state per camera has been reviewed. The builder is labeled art-directed fixed topology; fluid_simulation is false. No animation continuity or fill progression has been established.
findings.acceptance_check: If animation is delivered, inspect multiple neighboring/milestone frames or actual video and verify stream continuity, fill progression, no popping/intersections, and temporal noise.
